# Online Courses Club

> > Premium online courses covering 3D modeling, animation, game development, and graphic design with industry-standard tools like Maya, Cinema 4D, Unity, and Adobe Creative Suite.

Online Courses Club aggregates professional-level tutorials and courses from platforms like Skillshare, Lynda, Gnomon, and Udemy. The site focuses on intermediate to advanced creative software training taught by industry professionals including Patrick Foley, Lucas Ridley, and other experienced instructors.

## Key Topics

- Cinema 4D
- Autodesk Maya
- Unity Game Development
- Adobe Photoshop
- Adobe Illustrator
- After Effects
- 3D Modeling & Rendering
- Character Animation
- Motion Graphics
- UV Mapping & Texturing
- ZBrush Sculpting
- Blender
- Game Environment Design
- Typography & Logo Design
- HDRI Lighting

## 3D Animation & Character Design

- [Character Animation Mechanics and Emotion with Chris Kirshbaum](https://online-courses.club/character-animation-mechanics-and-emotion-with-chris-kirshbaum-gnomon): Intermediate Maya character animation mechanics by Chris Kirshbaum (Gnomon)
- [Maya for Beginners - Animation](https://online-courses.club/maya-for-beginners-animation): Beginner Maya animation principles & walk cycles by Lucas Ridley
- [Creating A Stylized Character in ZBrush](https://online-courses.club/creating-a-stylized-character-in-zbrush): Intermediate ZBrush character sculpting course by Joao Sousa
- [Making a Sci Fi Overall in Marvelous Designer 6.5](https://online-courses.club/making-a-sci-fi-overall-in-marvelous-designer-6-5-madina-chionidi): Beginner Marvelous Designer 6.5 sci-fi clothing by Madina Chionidi

## Game Development with Unity

- [Learn Unity 3D by coding a complete game start to finish C#](https://online-courses.club/learn-unity-3d-by-coding-a-complete-game-start-to-finish-c): Beginner Unity3D C# complete Crossy Road clone by School of Game Design
- [Hands-on Game Development with Unity 2018.1](https://online-courses.club/hands-on-game-development-with-unity-2018-1): Beginner Unity 2018.1 game development course by Raymundo Barrera
- [Unity Tech Art - Lighting VFX For Game Development](https://online-courses.club/unity-tech-art-lighting-vfx-for-game-development-udemy): Intermediate Unity lighting & VFX for games by Rick Davidson & Wilmer Lin
- [Blender - Interior Environments for Games](https://online-courses.club/blender-interior-environments-for-games): Intermediate Blender course on game interior modeling by Alan Thorn

## Cinema 4D & 3D Rendering

- [Cinema 4D and After Effects - Logo Animation and Compositing](https://online-courses.club/cinema-4d-and-after-effects-logo-animation-and-compositing): Intermediate Cinema 4D & After Effects course on logo animation by Craig Whitaker
- [Creating an Abstract Still Life in Cinema 4D](https://online-courses.club/creating-an-abstract-still-life-in-cinema-4d-skillshare): Intermediate Cinema 4D abstract 3D rendering by Patrick Foley (Skillshare)
- [Creating A Realistic Still Life in Cinema 4D](https://online-courses.club/creating-a-realistic-still-life-in-cinema-4d-skillshare): Intermediate Cinema 4D realistic rendering by Patrick Foley (Skillshare)
- [Create an Organic Abstract Form Using Soft Body Dynamics](https://online-courses.club/create-an-organic-abstract-form-using-soft-body-dynamics-skillshare): Beginner Cinema 4D soft body dynamics by Patrick Foley (Skillshare)

## Maya Texturing & UV Mapping

- [Maya for Beginners Texturing](https://online-courses.club/maya-for-beginners-texturing): Beginner Maya texturing & UV mapping fundamentals by Lucas Ridley
- [Maya Advanced Texturing](https://online-courses.club/maya-advanced-texturing-lynda): Advanced Maya texturing with Substance Painter & Mudbox by Andy Beane

## Motion Graphics & After Effects

- [Animate an Explainer Video in Adobe After Effects CC with Motion Graphics (Updated)](https://online-courses.club/animate-an-explainer-video-in-adobe-after-effects-cc-with-motion-graphics-updated): Beginner After Effects CC motion graphics explainer video by Lucas Ridley

## Adobe Creative Suite & Graphic Design

- [Illustrator CC 2018 - THE Illustrator Master Class](https://online-courses.club/illustrator-cc-2018-the-illustrator-master-class): Intermediate Illustrator CC 2018 master class covering logo & vector design
- [Digital 80s Design Combining Illustrator and Photoshop](https://online-courses.club/digital-80s-design-combining-illustrator-and-photoshop): Beginner 80s retro design combining Illustrator & Photoshop by James White
- [T-shirt design with Photoshop](https://online-courses.club/t-shirt-design-with-photoshop): Beginner-to-intermediate Photoshop CC t-shirt design by Gary Ajene

## Optional

- [Learning GREP with InDesign](https://online-courses.club/learning-grep-with-indesign-lynda): Intermediate InDesign GREP & regular expressions course by Michael Murphy
- [Revit Sprinkler Design](https://online-courses.club/revit-sprinkler-design): Intermediate Revit BIM fire protection & sprinkler design by Eric Wing
